source.title: Controlling cell adhesion and degradation of chitosan films by N-acetylation

processing.step: further N-acetylation of 91.5% DA chitin film
processing.evidence: Chitin films with 99.2% acetylation were synthesized by immersing 91.5% acetylated chitin films in a 10.0 molar excess of acetic anhydride

biology.cell_type: primary chick dorsal root ganglion (DRG) neurons (E9)

culture_days.evidence: Primary chick DRG neurons were cultured for 2 days on films of chitosan and N-acetylated chitosan

other_outcomes.evidence: chitin (DA ¼ 99:2%) showed a 4 times higher mass loss than chitosan (DA ¼ 0:5%) after 4 weeks of lysozyme treatment
other_outcomes.name: mass loss vs chitosan DA 0.5% after 4 weeks lysozyme

notes: Chitin films allowed neurite outgrowth despite low amine content.
